claim.statement: The guarded Crystal CPU DINOv3 embedding boundary matches an independent source-backed F32 reference over complete patches, prefix embeddings, patch coordinates, and RoPE cos/sin arrays for one deterministic non-zero 512px input.
claim.scope: One pinned local DINOv3 F32 checkpoint, one 512px CPU forward, one Apple Silicon host, and the embedding boundary only; this is not upstream Transformers-runtime, transformer-block, full-encoder, quality, GPU, or Metal parity.

dod: The source-backed reference verifies the full checkpoint hash and reads only the four certified F32 embedding roles.
Crystal checks the reference schema, pinned source hashes, input recipe digest, parameter digest, shapes, byte lengths, and every output value.
The numerical tolerance is bounded in code at 1e-5 absolute and 1e-5 relative; the observed maximum absolute error is 1.43e-6.
The default production budget remains closed, the RSS watchdog is 512 MiB, and no transformer block or Metal work runs.
Focused parity, CPU-only DINOv3/TRELLIS.2 suites, formatting, Python AST parsing, and the CPU-only no-codegen build pass.

excluded: upstream Transformers 5.8.1 DINOv3 runtime execution because it is unavailable in the current local Python environment
transformer blocks, final norm, full encoder, decoder, and mesh quality
latency, concurrency, and cross-host numerical variance

residual_risks: The reference reconstructs the pinned embedding semantics with PyTorch conv2d and explicit formulas; it is not a run of the unavailable Transformers 5.8.1 DINOv3 module.
The measured tolerance is one fresh-process Apple Silicon CPU comparison and may need remeasurement after changing the PyTorch, compiler, or host backend.
A digest receipt is not a file lock; same-size checkpoint replacement after verification remains outside this slice.
The parity result does not establish transformer-block correctness, full-encoder output quality, 1024px safety, GPU/Metal performance, or production readiness.
